clauses.name: Forfog, the Hanged
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Forfog is in the Interzone, whenever an opponent discards one or more cards, they lose 5 points.

clauses.name: Ehgog, the Livid
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Ehgog is in the Interzone, whenever a player discards one or more cards, a target manifestation on the field controlled by an opponent gets -1 power until the end of the turn.

clauses.name: Pale Entity
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Pale Entity is in the Interzone, whenever a player loses points or discards one or more cards, you gain 5 points.

clauses.name: Conflux of Catastrophe
clauses.printedParagraph: Whenever a player discards one or more cards, a target manifestation on the field controlled by an opponent gets -1 power.

clauses.name: Buddhan the Transcended
clauses.printedParagraph: When Buddhan the Transcended enters the field, put 3 Quiet counters on it and, as long as it is on the field, if due to cards or effects a manifestation loses power, a player discards cards or loses points, remove a Quiet counter from Buddhan the Transcended. When there are no Quiet counters on Buddhan the Transcended, it becomes of {H} temperament and gains: At the beginning of the turn, each player exiles a random manifestation from their Empathic Vessel.

clauses.name: Makaboon
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Makaboon is on the field, whenever a player discards one or more cards from their deck, in addition that player discards a card from their hand.

clauses.name: Otranth, the Bloodthirsty
clauses.printedParagraph: Otranth enters the field with 2 Shackle counters on it. Whenever a manifestation enters a Limbo, remove 1 Shackle counter from Otranth and, as long as there are no Shackle counters on it, it has Support.

clauses.name: Kanon, the Deathdealer
clauses.printedParagraph: For each Will discarded this way, a target Manifestation on the field controlled by an opponent gets -1 power.

supersededHistoricalInterpretation.note: Historical test ID retained for evidence identity; assertions now require discard events and Will penalties. The older report describes the previous interpretation, superseded by the explicit 2026-10-28 ruling.

limits: Eight selected clauses and their executed branches; not all abilities or combinations of these cards.
Ordinary movement methods and the multi-card discard result produce actual events. No synthetic cards_discarded stimulus is used to prove replaced discard watchers.

Replacement sources are explicit fixtures. Most network roots are controlled Pluff entry-trigger actions, not a complete Pluff play or entry journey. Kanon uses an actual Ponder declaration and payment.
The two network Otranth cases distinguish actual Limbo entry from suspension. Self-discard triggers such as Tombloom or Nghoul-ong outside Limbo remain a separate audit.
Group counts are checked for one multi-card discard action. Multiple separate discard instructions before one event flush are outside this batch.

Kanon keeps its existing public discardedCardIds list restricted to ordinary Limbo/Support movements; the Will penalty now counts all successful discards without exposing private suspended/exiled identities.
Network checks use delta and legacy clients, live-server reconnect, choices and priority passes; automatic phase driving is isolated.
No new card UI, Safari, physical-device, process-restart or illustration certification.
